worldcombat.skill.aquastep.summary: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.use.0: Tap a few beats around the target, then spin
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.use.1: Sweep everyone standing in the ring
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.use.2: Boost Speed, then either back off or press in
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.description.0: The spin deals %1$s damage, dancing %2$s beats around the target at %3$s blocks each, %4$s s per beat.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.description.1: Spin within %1$s blocks. Outer targets take %2$s damage. A hit raises Speed by %3$s stages and pushes the target back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.twirl.on: Twirl: circle the target and finish from behind, a trickier angle that costs two extra beats in the open.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.twirl.off: Tap: hop left and right out front, quicker and safer but with a plain angle.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.preference.tw: On: circle the target and finish from behind. Off: hop left and right out front, quicker.
worldcombat.skill.aquastep.preference.ai: Only start dancing when the foe is within this range; smaller stays glued, larger closes in from farther.
Back off to this distance after the spin before deciding again; larger is less attached, smaller keeps pressing.
